title: Applying TF-IDF Weighting Method and BM-25 Algorithm in Myanmar News Retrieval
venue: 2025 20th International Joint Symposium on Artificial Intelligence and Natural Language Processing (iSAI-NLP)
abstract: In the digital era, efficient information retrieval plays a pivotal role in accessing and analyzing vast amounts of textual data. This study explores the application of the Term Frequency-Inverse Document Frequency (TF-IDF) weighting method in the context of Myanmar news retrieval. Myanmar, a country undergoing rapid socio-political and economic changes, necessitates effective methods for information retrieval to support decision-making processes and promote transparency. The TF-IDF weighting method, a classic technique in information retrieval, calculates the importance of terms in documents relative to a corpus, facilitating more accurate document ranking and retrieval. This research assesses the efficacy of TF-IDF in the context of Myanmar news retrieval by analyzing a corpus of Myanmar news articles. Experimental results demonstrate the effectiveness of TF-IDF in improving the relevance and precision of search results, providing insights into its potential applications in enhancing information access and analysis in Myanmar's dynamic media landscape. This study contributes to the advancement of information retrieval techniques tailored to diverse linguistic contexts, aiding researchers and practitioners in optimizing search functionalities for Myanmar news platforms.
